style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, blazing white sunlit interior
character: glossy dark red leech, thick ribbed body, no legs at all, round spectacles, a banker's collar behind his head, tired eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: a clear tube fixed to his tail sucker, running back to a glass jar labelled КРЕДИТ in big cyrillic capitals that fills with red as he goes; two clerk mites riding him, one hammering a stamp, one unrolling a ledger strip - their place is his back, never the floor, until 8.0
prop_continuity: the tube on his tail all ten seconds; his body pales from dark red to grey as the jar fills; water spraying off him every window
motion_rule: every window he surges forward along the flooded hall toward the lens, whole body undulating, his front sucker and mouth free and never attached to anything; he shoulders at the mites and they keep their grip; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: a flooded bank hall, clear water over white marble, huge windows blazing with hard midday sun, spray flying gold in the beams; the hall glows white end to end

audio.delivery: flat tired male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: MOY, BANK, VY-dal, kre-DEET, TAK, ya, te-PER, DOL-zhen, ye-MU, po-SLED-ney, KAP-li, KRO-vi
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.05
audio.lip_sync: the leech talks like a person, his front sucker opens and closes clearly on every syllable like a mouth, never a voice over
audio.sfx: water sloshing, tube gurgling, stamp thud

timeline.a: his front sucker slaps open at the lens, water bursting up into the sunbeam
timeline.c: big close on his mouth, push in

timeline.a: he surges at the lens down the flooded hall, the stamp mite hammering the stamp into his back
he throws his head sideways, the tube snaps taut and drags the jar skidding through the water at the lens
timeline.c: big close on the taut tube, whip

timeline.a: he drives on toward the windows, the ledger mite unrolling a ledger strip down his flank
he rams his shoulder into the water, spray flying at the lens, both mites swinging out sideways still hooked in him
he heaves into the window light, his dark red draining to grey along his whole body
still surging at the lens, he lifts his grey head as the jar behind him fills up
timeline.c: big close low frontal, push in

timeline.a: the grey leech bursts through the last sheet of water onto the sunlit marble
timeline.c: tight to mid low, pulling back

timeline.a: both mites leap off onto a fat dark red leech surging up alongside and hammer a fresh stamp into its back
the camera keeps pulling out - a whole hall of identical grey leeches surging in lanes, each dragging a full red jar with the same КРЕДИТ label
timeline.c: pull back to low wide, the hall filling frame

must_appear: the tube fixed to his tail all ten seconds; the jar filling red behind him; his body turning grey by 7.05; the hall of identical grey leeches and full red jars at 8.9
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, any lettering other than КРЕДИТ, Latin letters on the jar, a static camera, a static wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking, his mouth or sucker attached to anything, the tube on his mouth or head, the tube coming off his tail, a mite on the floor before 8.0, a mite doing nothing before 8.0, a gap between the leech and the mites before 8.0, props hovering motionless in mid-air, a leech with legs or arms, fins, English speech, any word after 7.05
